scope: Render-call JavaScript CPU submission time only; excludes GPU completion/compositing/network/input. Not directly comparable with historical Canvas per-pixel timings. Separate one-second samples under uncontrolled concurrent browser workload. No physical-device benchmark.

medium.environment: Headless Chrome on Windows; desktop 1440x900 viewport; three authenticated desktop game clients; not a physical-device benchmark

low.environment: Headless Chrome on Windows; emulated 1066x600 touch viewport; not a physical phone benchmark
